svg.title: Real people from published studies: Small Print vs the age table
svg.desc: Grouped bar chart of real, published clinical data (not a simulation). Pondicherry, India · push-up (n=283), Small Print start: 86.2% within ±0.50 D, 63.6% within ±0.25 D; Pondicherry, India · push-up (n=283), Age table (40 cm): 84.8% within ±0.50 D, 60.1% within ±0.25 D; Madrid, Spain · defocus curve (n=13), Small Print start: 92.3% within ±0.50 D, 46.2% within ±0.25 D; Madrid, Spain · defocus curve (n=13), Age table (40 cm): 69.2% within ±0.50 D, 30.8% within ±0.25 D; Both clinical datasets (n=296), Small Print start: 86.5% within ±0.50 D, 62.8% within ±0.25 D; Both clinical datasets (n=296), Age table (40 cm): 84.1% within ±0.50 D, 58.8% within ±0.25 D. Short-sighted people (distance SE below −1.00 D, n=23): the age table offered readers to 23; Small Print withheld them from 12.
svg.text: Real people from published studies: Small Print vs the age table
Starting strength vs the clinician's near prescription (distance Rx + add), at 40 cm. Higher is better.
Share of in-scope people whose starting pair is within the tolerance (wrong outcome = miss)
